body: This van is a dream on wheels, packed with top-notch features for the ultimate van life experience.

The power system is impressive with a 100W solar system paired with an 800Ah Lithium Ion Battery and a 3000W power inverter/charger, ensuring you're always powered up, wherever the road takes you. The 30A shore power plugin and a 50Amp DC-DC/solar battery charger keep your adventures seamless. Enjoy the convenience of a 33-gallon freshwater tank, greywater system with an electric dump valve, and both an indoor tiled shower and an outdoor rear door shower.

Stay comfortable in any climate with a Maxxair Deluxe ceiling vent fan, a 12v roof-mounted Nomadic A/C unit, and an Espar diesel-powered cabin heater. The van's interior is beautifully designed with painted shiplap siding, a wood-stained ceiling, dimmable LED ceiling lights, and vinyl wood-style flooring. It also features a fully-equipped kitchen with an Acacia butcher block countertop, a stainless steel sink, an in-counter double burner induction cooktop, and an Isotherm Cruise 130 refrigerator with freezer.

Additional amenities include a memory foam queen bed, swivel passenger and driver seats, a WeBoost cell signal booster, and all-terrain wheels and tires. Whether you're new to van life or a seasoned traveler, this custom camper van offers everything you need for an unforgettable journey.
